script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: The Unseen Bridge

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

JESSICA (30s, a kind-hearted woman) sits at a table with her laptop open, sipping her coffee. She types diligently as customers come and go.

JESSICA: (under her breath) Come on, just a little further...

The door opens, and in walks JAMES (early 30s, a friendly-looking man). He notices Jessica's intense focus and walks over.

JAMES: (smiling) Having a productive day, I see.

Jessica looks up, surprised.

JESSICA: (smiling back) Oh, hi James. Yes, just trying to finish up this chapter.

JAMES: (leaning against the table) Care for some company? I've got some time to kill.

Jessica hesitates but ultimately nods.

JESSICA: Alright, but please be warned – I'm not much for small talk.

James chuckles and takes a seat across from her.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - LATER

They've been chatting for hours, and Jessica has revealed her deepest dreams – to write a novel that can inspire and bring people together. James listens intently, sharing stories of his own.

JAMES: You know, Jessica, I used to write poetry when I was younger. I'd give anything to have those words back.

Jessica smiles sympathetically.

JESSICA: We can't always go back and change the past, James, but we can make the most of the present and look forward to the future.

EXT. PARK - DAY (SCENE 2)

They've decided to take their writing to the park, spreading a blanket out under the sun. Jessica brings her laptop, and James brings a sketchbook and pencils.

They spend hours writing, sharing ideas and encouraging each other. The sun starts to set, and the park begins to empty.

JAMES: (packing up his things) Well, I suppose I should get going.

Jessica looks up, surprised.

JESSICA: Already? It seems like just a moment ago we arrived.

JAMES: (smiling) Time flies when you're having fun. But I'll be back tomorrow, if you'll have me.

Jessica smiles, and they exchange a warm hug.

INT. JESSICA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jessica sits at her dining table, staring at a blank page. She's lost in thought about her conversation with James.

Suddenly, her phone rings. It's James.

JESSICA: (answering the call) Hello, James.

JAMES: (over the phone) Hey, Jessica. I couldn't sleep, and I started thinking about our conversation today. I had an idea for your novel.

Jessica listens intently as James shares his thoughts, and her mind begins to spin with possibilities.

EXT. LIBRARY - DAY (SCENE 3)

They spend the following days at the library, pouring over books, researching, and writing. Their friendship deepens, and their project begins to take shape.

INT. JESSICA'S APARTMENT - EVENING

Months later, the first draft of their collaborative novel is complete. Jessica and James sit on her couch, exhausted but elated.

JAMES: (grinning) I think we've got something really special here, Jessica.

JESSICA: (smiling) I couldn't agree more. We've created something that I believe can make a difference in people's lives.

JAMES: And we did it together.

Jessica nods, and they share a heartfelt hug.

EXT. BOOK STORE - DAY (SCENE 4)

Their novel, "The Unseen Bridge," is finally published, and they've come to a local bookstore for its release. Friends, family, and fans gather to celebrate their achievement.

James and Jessica take the stage, looking nervous but excited.

JAMES: (taking a deep breath) We'd like to thank all of you for coming today to celebrate the release of our book, "The Unseen Bridge."

JESSICA: And we'd like to thank each other for being the unseen bridge in our lives, helping us to believe in ourselves and our dreams.

James and Jessica share a smile before opening the floor for questions.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
